say:1:1322124001:1.text: I was wondering when you'd come back! Recently, I found a method in an old Bantus scroll that can suppress mad Graveborn.
say:1:1322124001:1.source_cn: 你们来了，真巧，我正想去找你们。前些天我在一份来自班题...

say:2:1322124002:1.text: I spent a few days studying it and talked it over with Valka. We believe this method could be effective on the undead here!
say:2:1322124002:1.source_cn: 我研究了几天，也找瓦丽卡姐姐讨论过，我们都觉得这个方法...

choice_prompt:3:1322124002.text: I spent a few days studying it and talked it over with Valka. We believe this method could be effective on the undead here!
choice_prompt:3:1322124002.source_cn: 我研究了几天，也找瓦丽卡姐姐讨论过，我们都觉得这个方法或许对活死人也有用。

say:4:1322124003:1.text: The undead here are like Graveborn who have lost all their reasoning... Considering everything that we've seen, they do have similarities to a type of madness.
say:4:1322124003:1.source_cn: 活死人就是失去了理智的亡灵……仔细想想，和“发狂”确实...

say:5:1322124005:1.text: The scroll says that if you can find what triggered the madness in the Graveborn and repeatedly expose them to it, there's a chance they might regain some sanity, even if only briefly.
say:5:1322124005:1.source_cn: 文献里记载，如果能找到发狂亡灵的刺激源——也就是让他们...

say:6:1322124006:1.text: During this brief period of clarity, the mad Graveborn can regain some self-control and may even be fully subdued by strong enough Divine Light.
say:6:1322124006:1.source_cn: 在这段有理智的时间内，发狂的亡灵能够进行一定程度的自我...

say:7:1322124007:1.text: So you're saying we first need to help the undead regain some of their memory and sanity and then purify them with Divine Light?
say:7:1322124007:1.source_cn: 所以你的意思是……先想办法让活死人找回记忆和理智，然后...
say:7:1322124007:1.male: So you're saying we first need to help the undead regain some of their memory and sanity and then purify them with Divine Light?
say:7:1322124007:1.female: So you're saying we first need to help the undead regain some of their memory and sanity and then purify them with Divine Light?

say:8:1322124008:1.text: With so many undead, how can we possibly help them regain even a bit of memory and sanity? Even a few seconds seems impossible...
say:8:1322124008:1.source_cn: 那么多活死人，我们该怎样才能让他们找回一定记忆和理智？...

say:9:1322124009:1.text: Valka said she would find a way to solve this problem. My task is to find an acolyte who is willing to help us.
say:9:1322124009:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡姐姐说她会想办法解决这个问题，而我得去找愿意帮助...

say:10:1322124010:1.text: Next, I want to have a serious discussion with the head of the temple and hope they'll assist me in using the Divine Light to purify the undead.
say:10:1322124010:1.source_cn: 所以……接下来我想和修道院的负责人好好谈一谈，希望他们...

choice_prompt:11:1322124010.text: Next, I want to have a serious discussion with the head of the temple and hope they'll assist me in using the Divine Light to purify the undead.
choice_prompt:11:1322124010.source_cn: 所以……接下来我想和修道院的负责人好好谈一谈，希望他们能协助我，用圣光的力量来试着净化活死人。

say:12:1322124011:1.text: I've got an idea! Ogden and Maxim, the acolytes we saved, are friendly with us. We could ask them for assistance.
say:12:1322124011:1.source_cn: 我有个想法，那两位被我们救过的修士——奥格列和马克西姆...

say:13:1322124012:1.text: Of course! They have to help us! We're their heroes!
say:13:1322124012:1.source_cn: 对呀！我们曾经救过他们，他们应该会愿意帮助我们！

say:14:1322124013:1.text: We'll go to the temple with you, Carolina. Acolyte Ogden and Maxim are good people. Tell them your reasons, and I'm sure they'll agree to help.
say:14:1322124013:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜，我们和你一起去修道院吧。他们两位都是虔诚又善...

say:15:1322124014:1.text: Thank you. It looks like I'll need you to accompany me through the <style="highlight">secret passage to the temple</style> once again.
say:15:1322124014:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们。看来又得麻烦你们和我一起<style=hig...

choice:11:0:1.text: We have to go to the temple then.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 看来不得不去修道院了
choice:11:0:1.male: We have to go to the temple then.
choice:11:0:1.female: We have to go to the temple then.

choice:11:1:2.text: Acolytes Ogden and Maxim can help.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 奥格列和马克西姆或许可以帮忙
choice:11:1:2.male: Acolytes Ogden and Maxim can help.
choice:11:1:2.female: Acolytes Ogden and Maxim can help.

choice:3:0:1.text: Mad Graveborn and the undead here are similar.
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 发狂的亡灵和活死人确实很相似
choice:3:0:1.male: Mad Graveborn and the undead here are similar.
choice:3:0:1.female: Mad Graveborn and the undead here are similar.

say:17:1322124004:1.text: Yes, and they have a lot of in-depth research on gravecalling magic and Graveborn history.
say:17:1322124004:1.source_cn: 嗯，他们对亡灵法术和亡灵本身都有着很深入的研究。

choice:3:1:2.text: Bantus is truly a Graveborn kingdom.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 班题斯不愧是亡灵帝国
choice:3:1:2.male: Bantus is truly a Graveborn kingdom.
choice:3:1:2.female: Bantus is truly a Graveborn kingdom.
